evidence: STOP PRINT (top bar, every view) and UNLOCK (SETUP/MACHINE recovery row) render a white/cream label on a gold fill. These are the app's two mid-tier safety controls and their labels are near-invisible.

recommendation: Map Quasar `warning` to a token that carries dark text (e.g. GOLD fill + INK label, or WARN_WASH fill + GOLD_DIM border + INK text), and register it in ui.colors() so no default Quasar color can leak into safety controls.

evidence: The two highest-stakes colors on screen are off-palette Quasar defaults, not Oracle tokens: EMERGENCY STOP, RESET / ABORT and every error toast use default `negative` (#C10015, bright signal red), STOP PRINT/UNLOCK/Confirm use default `warning` (#F2C037).
